confirmation-dialog.purpose: Interrupt a user only when an action has meaningful consequence and needs explicit review, cancellation, or confirmation.
useWhen: An action is destructive, financial, permission-sensitive, irreversible, or audit-relevant.
Users need to understand affected entities and consequence before proceeding.
The product needs an explicit cancel path and result feedback.
doNotUseWithoutReview: The action is simple, reversible, and already clear.
The dialog repeats the button label without naming consequence.
The system needs a full review step instead of a modal interruption.
foundations: Defines dialog width, footer action order, and responsive fit.
Names affected entity, consequence, primary action, cancel, and recovery.
Controls destructive tone, focus, primary action, and disabled/loading states.
Dialog overlays the task and blocks only the relevant action.
Closed, open, confirming, loading, success, error, and cancelled states are explicit.
Requires role dialog, labelled title, focus management, Escape, and focus restoration.
variants: Danger tone with named affected entity.
Validation/error explains why action cannot proceed.
motion: Opens after user action and respects reduced motion.
Primary action can enter loading before result feedback.
accessibility: Dialog has a title and consequence copy.
Focus moves into the dialog after open.
Escape and cancel avoid side effects.
Primary action text names the consequence.
tests: Trigger opens dialog only after user action.

canDecide: Use Confirmation Dialog for clear destructive or consequential actions.
Write confirmation copy that names the entity and consequence.
Use danger tone only when risk is meaningful.
mustAsk: Consequence, affected entity, recovery, audit, or ownership is unclear.
The action affects money, access, compliance, identity, or irreversible state.
rejectIf: It confirms a trivial reversible action.
Cancel path or result feedback is missing.
miel.handoff: Confirm consequence, affected entity, action owner, recovery, audit, and result feedback.
